'''Abrihom''' was a supply [[Space station/Legends|station]] platform located within the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], it was destroyed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
